automatedCases.reason: The stable static, unit, sanitizer, build, package, reproducibility, install-tree, rollback, uninstall, and provenance gate passes.
Complete normal frames provide Aurorae fallback across the static scale and state matrix.
Eight original core icons and the Fedora inheritance chain pass real Qt resolution and render checks.
KDE click policy, mnemonic behavior, focus, and scrollbar hit geometry pass the native Qt probe.
Shell, session, asset, accessibility, diagnostic, and reproducibility contracts pass their phase gates.
Public v6 install, v6-to-v7 upgrade, repeated install, rollback, uninstall, fresh install, RPM verification, doctor, and configuration preservation pass in disposable Fedora 44.

liveCases.reason: True KWin maximization spans every required single and mixed output without unpainted decoration regions; mixed-output transitions recompose correctly.
All reported core and session icons render visibly and distinctly through the active NoxForge icon theme; document-print demonstrates the intentional Breeze fallback.
System Settings, Dolphin, Konsole, Firefox, Qt menus, dialogs, quick tiles, full screen, and minimized tasks compose coherently.
All panel edges, launcher, task manager, tray, calendar, notification, dialog, tooltip, and OSD surfaces compose without seams.
The verified RPM payload renders SDDM test mode, Logout, production Splash, and a held many-window TabBox with visible semantics.
Injected keyboard and pointer input verifies focus, Alt mnemonics, target activation, RTL, translation expansion, and normal, reduced, and slow motion settling.

limitations.reason: The virtual output cannot qualify physical hardware blur quality.
The KWin virtual backend exposes a synthetic default pointer, so physical NoxForge cursor appearance is not claimed.
No physical speaker or headphone route is attached to the disposable environment.
SDDM test mode does not exercise PAM authentication or real power actions.
